changes: — SECTION_11.md v11.45 + Workout Reference Library v0.8 + sync.py v3.113 + push.py v0.6 (2026-07-16) —

v11.45: Evidence-Gated Torque Training — Section 11 B now requires an event demand, repeated controlled-session limiter, or measured force-cadence deficit before prescribing `SE-*`, plus full readiness and musculoskeletal/bike-fit safety gates.
Workout Reference Library v0.8: Expands the catalog to 41 templates, revises SE-1/SE-2, and adds SE-3 maximal-torque pedal cycles plus SE-4 low-cadence VO2 intervals.

Torque planning rules: A single sore-leg ride or cadence collapse is not a torque indication; high-cadence coordination maps to AE-5, while combined cadence/power fade requires pacing, recovery, heat, fueling, hydration, and gearing checks first.

Torque sequencing: SE-1/SE-2/SE-4 default to one replacement session per week for 3–6 weeks; MDF-gated SE-3 preserves the studied 10-week, twice-weekly resistance dose while labeling individual weekly integration as conservative extrapolation.

Torque audit: Every SE-* selection requires a non-null torque_gate object with gate results, dated evidence, safety confirmation, replaced slot, raw-stream screen records, and MDF/load-mapping references.
sync.py v3.113: Emits metadata.last_updated as offset-aware UTC so the torque gate's 24-hour freshness check is stable across local and GitHub runners.
Zwift execution: Sustained torque work may use ERG only when stable; maximal-torque SE-3 requires Resistance, Slope, or Free Ride mode and must not use ERG.
Upgrade: pull fresh SECTION_11.md, SKILL.md, README.md, examples/sync.py, examples/workout-library/, examples/agentic/, manifest.json, and changelog.json.
